Picture a plain kanban board, with columns from Backlog to Done, save that AI agents take up the cards. They report their progress, ask when they stick, and ever await thy thumbs up.

AI-gile is a kanban board where the company is made of AI agents. Each project hath a lead who planneth the work and helpers who build it. When a feature is ready, an AI tester trieth it and taketh a screenshot, then it landeth in thy pile. Accept it, or comment and they rework it.

It began as one mortal's way of keeping watch over many AI coding sessions at once, and grew into a proper board. It runneth on thy machine, needeth no account, and hath no trackers. It is free for friends and the curious. It is also unfinished, so expect rough edges and the odd surprise.

Here is the honest tale. Thou must still have the ideas, and thou must still prove the results. What AI-gile doth is all that lieth betwixt: it keepeth the cards in order, waketh the right agent when thou commentest, sheweth exactly what changed, and gathereth all of it into one short pile for thee.

AI-gile is a free kanban board that thou runnest upon thine own computer. In place of folk, each project hath a company of AI agents: a lead who turneth thine ideas into cards and a plan, and helpers who take up the cards in order of weight. When a thing is built, an AI tester followeth the test steps and sheweth thee what it saw. Then it awaiteth in one pile named For thee. Thou acceptest it, or thou commentest and the company hath another go. Naught ever reacheth Done without thee.

Some things thou mightest not expect. A night watch keepeth the To do column filled whilst thou sleepest, choosing cards that need no answer from thee. A token counter sheweth how much the agents have spent this day and this week, and No Token Mode biddeth them cease their spending. Thou canst send missives to friends, and private missives are end-to-end encrypted. The board speaketh about 120 tongues, Dutch, Flemish, pirate and Klingon among them. None of it costeth a penny, and none is trying to sell it thee.

AI-gile is a small, personal undertaking, not a company. Rich desired to tend several AI coding projects without opening every app to look in on them, so he and the agents built a board for it, then used the board to build the rest of itself. It is in closed pre-alpha, which meaneth it worketh, mostly, for a handful of friends. There is no price page, no newsletter and no plan for growth. If it soundeth useful, thou mayest ask to try it when it openeth a little more.

AI-gile is a kanban board for one mortal and a great many AI agents. It runneth on thine own computer and is wholly free. Thou addest projects, and each project getteth a lead and a small company. Thou chattest with the lead, a little like Discord, and describest an idea; the lead turneth it into cards and a plan, then waiteth for thee to press Go. The company worketh through the cards in order of weight, using a plain command line made for language models. Ere aught cometh back to thee, an AI tester followeth the steps in a copy of the app and attacheth a screenshot. Finished work landeth in thy pile with the changed files and the diff. Thou acceptest it, or thou leavest a comment and the company waketh and tries again. Only thou canst move a card to Done.

A day with AI-gile, roughly. At eventide thou leavest a few comments: this button is in the wrong place, that list should be sorted, might we have a dark mode. Thou goest to bed. The agents read the comments, make the changes, prove them and hand them back to thee. If To do runneth dry, the night watch filleth it from the backlog with cards that need no answer from thee. At morn there is one short pile: a couple of questions and a few things to try, each with steps a sleepy mortal may follow and a screenshot of it working. Thou clickest through, acceptest the good ones and sendest back the rest. A token counter sheweth what it all spent, and No Token Mode is there for lean weeks. Then thou breakfastest, wherein the agents cannot yet help.

First, what AI-gile is not. It is not a startup, it is not for sale, and none is gathering thy data. It is a free board that runneth on thy computer, with no accounts, no trackers and no cookies. What it is: one tidy place to see every AI coding project at once, with a company of agents doing the cards and thee making the decisions. It foldeth related cards together, mendeth muddled titles, and keepeth watch that the code stay lean. It speaketh about 120 tongues, from Dutch and Flemish to pirate and Klingon. Friends may send each other missives, privately and encrypted. It was built by Rich and a great number of patient agents, mostly using itself. It is in closed pre-alpha, so it is rough in places. If it soundeth like merriment, ask kindly and thou mayest enter early.
